items.title: Three constructions of the quasi-coherent sheaf associated to a module over the ring of global sections agree
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file modules.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement gives three constructions of the quasi-coherent sheaf associated to a module over the ring of global sections, proves them canonically isomorphic and records four properties including quasi-coherence, commutation with colimits and the adjunction formula (author lemma at source lines 1346-1399, label lemma-construct-quasi-coherent-sheaves). The proof (source lines 1401-1421) identifies the sheafification construction with the pullback, obtains the cokernel construction from the right exactness and the compatibility with direct sums of the pullback, and then reads the four properties off the corresponding properties of the pullback and the adjunction (proof lines 1406-1419). The comparison of the three constructions is the content. H2.
